    Right tau-sequences in literal finite-module factor categories #

    This file descends the chosen ambient right Auslander--Reiten meshes through the literal quotient by maps factoring through selected labels. The raw quotient mesh retains the radical approximation and weak-kernel properties; only its possibly zero left boundary requires minimalization.
